margin_pct.quote: Gross margin during the thirteen weeks ended September 24, 2026 increased $19.4 million, or 3.8%, compared to the corresponding prior year period. The increase in gross profit was primarily driven by the 3.0% increase in net sales and an increase in gross margin to 43.7%, up approximately 30 basis points from 43.4% in the corresponding prior year period.
